auftrag: Read the case file. Then solve five puzzles.

saetze: It is small, round and very old.
It was a present from a king and it points to secret places on old maps.
The compass was kept in the Map Room on the second floor.
Dr Cole saw it there on Monday at six pm.
At seven pm Agent Wren locked the room.
On Tuesday morning the compass was gone, but the door was still locked.
Three people have a key: Agent Wren, Mr Hale and Dr Cole.
Sam, the cook, brings lunch to the Academy every day, but he has no key.
A note lay on the table.
It says: Take the nine forty-two train to Brighton.

raetsel.frage: Tap the sentence that tells you the door was still locked.
raetsel.hilfe2: It is the last sentence of the second paragraph.

raetsel.frage: What is special about the compass?
optionen: It plays music when it is opened.
It tells the time in Brighton.
It points to secret places on old maps.

raetsel.frage: True or false? “Sam has a key to the Map Room.”
raetsel.hilfe2: Sam brings lunch. Does he have a key?
raetsel.rtyp: True, false or not in the text

raetsel.frage: What does "locked" mean in: Agent Wren locked the room?
raetsel.hilfe1: Think about the key in the next sentence.
raetsel.hilfe2: You need a key to lock a door.

raetsel.frage: Put the words in the right order. It is a sentence from the file.
raetsel.hilfe1: The sentence starts with the time.
